text.text_excerpt: We stayed for a week through Interval. The front desk was always attentive and helpful. The resort offers Sunday continental breakfast (regular continental breakfast but does come with mimosas), Monday taste of New Orleans (pretty good pasta and other little bites again with mimosas), and Tuesday (wine and cheese at jazz club next door). Events were nice and free. We stayed in 409, one bedroom with full kitchen. Saw one cockroach but didn't make it a big deal. Didnt really cook in the room as we ate out mostly. Housekeeping everyday. Overall clean. Not a lot of windows, just one actually, not a problem just a note. Truly walking distance to many things: bourbon st, Frenchman st (little fu...

Quaint hotel right in the heart of the French Quarter. Stayed here during the week of Mardi Gras and it was a great location (such a quick walk to Bourbon St!). They're available for booking through RCI. They had a "Taste of New Orleans" event where they brought in catered food from a local restaurant and had it in the courtyard, which was a nice touch. In terms of the rooms, we stayed on the third floor which you can access via elevator or the stairway. There were stairs in our room which was kinda cool, and a pullout bed built into the couch. There was a kitchen with a fridge and all the basic cooking amenities. They have bath and body works products for the toiletries. Surprisingly you...

My Aunt loves New Orleans, so when her week to use her timeshare here came up and she couldn't go, I jumped at her offer to go in her place. We stayed in her allotted room which was one bedroom, one bath, there was also a small living room with a full size pull out couch and a full kitchen. We were right by the center patio area and even had a separate door with direct access to it, which we did use to take advantage of the hot tub. The location is perfect, everything is a 5 minute walk away, Bourbon St, Jackson Square, the famous Cafe Du Monde, etc. Would definitely stay here again!
